h: Davido's Ghana rep says promoter owes money over short concert performance
p: Davido's Ghanaian representative has reportedly blamed an unresolved payment dispute for the singer's brief performance at an event organised by Great Osama. He claimed the balance due on arrival was never paid as agreed.
body: Davido's Ghanaian representative, Sabi Boi, has reportedly spoken out on the controversy over the Afrobeats star's short performance at an event organised by Great Osama in Ghana.
In a TikTok Live session on Monday, 23 November 2026, Sabi Boi claimed that the organiser owed Davido's team money, and dismissed suggestions that the promoter had paid huge sums for the show.

According to him, the arrangement was for the organiser to pay a deposit before the show and the rest once Davido arrived at the venue, but the second payment was not made as agreed. He also claimed the promoter tried to settle the balance with gold instead of cash.
No response from Great Osama to the claims was included in the reports.
more: Davido's rep says the balance was not paid.
He claims the promoter offered gold instead of cash.
